audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra offering instruction text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for guilt/reparation offering, priestly portions, peace/well-being offering types, thanksgiving, vow/freewill, fat/blood prohibitions, wave/contribution portions.

verses.restored: This is instruction/Torah of guilt/reparation offering: Holy of Holies it is.

familiar.text: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.

modern.text: “Now this is the law of the guilt offering, which is most holy:

original.text: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הָאָשָׁ֑ם קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא

verses.restored: In place where burnt offering is slaughtered, guilt/reparation offering shall be slaughtered, and its blood/life shall be thrown against altar all around.

familiar.text: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.

modern.text: The guilt offering must be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and the priest shall sprinkle its blood on all sides of the altar.

original.text: בִּמְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁחֲטוּ֙ אֶת הָ֣עֹלָ֔ה יִשְׁחֲט֖וּ אֶת הָאָשָׁ֑ם וְאֶת דָּמ֛וֹ יִזְרֹ֥ק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: All its fat he shall bring near from it: fat tail, fat covering inward parts,

familiar.text: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,

modern.text: And all the fat from it shall be offered: the fat tail, the fat that covers the entrails,

original.text: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל חֶלְבּ֖וֹ יַקְרִ֣יב מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֵ֚ת הָֽאַלְיָ֔ה וְאֶת הַחֵ֖לֶב הַֽמְכַסֶּ֥ה אֶת הַקֶּֽרֶב

verses.restored: two kidneys and fat on them by loins, and lobe on liver; with kidneys he shall remove it.

familiar.text: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:

modern.text: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.

original.text: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת הַחֵ֨לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶ֨רֶת֙ עַל הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽנָּה

verses.restored: The priest shall turn them into smoke on altar, fire-offering to YHWH; it is guilt/reparation offering.

familiar.text: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a trespass offering.

modern.text: The priest shall burn them on the altar as an offering made by fire to the LORD; it is a guilt offering.

original.text: וְהִקְטִ֨יר אֹתָ֤ם הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה אָשָׁ֖ם הֽוּא

verses.restored: Every male among priests may eat it; in holy place it shall be eaten. Holy of Holies it is.

familiar.text: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.

modern.text: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It must be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.

original.text: כָּל זָכָ֥ר בַּכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יֹאכְלֶ֑נּוּ בְּמָק֤וֹם קָדוֹשׁ֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא

verses.restored: Like sin/misalignment offering, so guilt/reparation offering; one Torah/instruction for them. The priest who makes atonement/covering with it, to him it shall belong.

familiar.text: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.

modern.text: The guilt offering is like the sin offering; the same law applies to both. It belongs to the priest who makes atonement with it.

original.text: כַּֽחַטָּאת֙ כָּֽאָשָׁ֔ם תּוֹרָ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לָהֶ֑ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר בּ֖וֹ ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: The priest bringing near burnt offering of a man, skin of burnt offering that he brought near belongs to priest.

familiar.text: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.

modern.text: As for the priest who presents a burnt offering for anyone, the hide of that offering belongs to him.

original.text: וְהַ֨כֹּהֵ֔ן הַמַּקְרִ֖יב אֶת עֹ֣לַת אִ֑ישׁ ע֤וֹר הָֽעֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְרִ֔יב לַכֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: Every grain offering baked in oven, and all made in pan and on griddle, belongs to priest who brings it near.

familiar.text: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.

modern.text: Likewise, every grain offering that is baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who presents it,

original.text: וְכָל מִנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תֵּֽאָפֶה֙ בַּתַּנּ֔וּר וְכָל נַעֲשָׂ֥ה בַמַּרְחֶ֖שֶׁת וְעַֽל מַחֲבַ֑ת לַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַמַּקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ ל֥וֹ תִֽהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: Every grain offering mixed with oil or dry belongs to all sons of Aaron, each as his brother.

familiar.text: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.

modern.text: and every grain offering, whether dry or mixed with oil, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron. The Peace Offering (Leviticus 3:1–17)

original.text: וְכָל מִנְחָ֥ה בְלוּלָֽה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וַחֲרֵבָ֑ה לְכָל בְּנֵ֧י אַהֲרֹ֛ן תִּהְיֶ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ כְּאָחִֽיו

verses.restored: This is instruction/Torah of sacrifice of peace/well-being offering that one brings near to YHWH.

familiar.text: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.

modern.text: Now this is the law of the peace offering that one may present to the LORD:

original.text: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֖יב לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: If he brings it near for thanksgiving, then he shall bring near with sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, unleavened wafers spread with oil, and cakes of fine flour well mixed with oil.

familiar.text: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

modern.text: If he offers it in thanksgiving, then along with the sacrifice of thanksgiving he shall offer unleavened cakes mixed with olive oil, unleavened wafers coated with oil, and well-kneaded cakes of fine flour mixed with oil.

original.text: אִ֣ם עַל תּוֹדָה֮ יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ֒ וְהִקְרִ֣יב עַל זֶ֣בַח הַתּוֹדָ֗ה חַלּ֤וֹת מַצּוֹת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן וְסֹ֣לֶת מֻרְבֶּ֔כֶת חַלֹּ֖ת בְּלוּלֹ֥ת בַּשָּֽׁמֶן

verses.restored: With cakes of leavened bread he shall bring near his offering with sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace/well-being offerings.

familiar.text: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

modern.text: Along with his peace offering of thanksgiving he is to present an offering with cakes of leavened bread.

original.text: עַל חַלֹּת֙ לֶ֣חֶם חָמֵ֔ץ יַקְרִ֖יב קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ עַל זֶ֖בַח תּוֹדַ֥ת שְׁלָמָֽיו

verses.restored: From it he shall bring near one from each offering as contribution to YHWH; it shall belong to priest who throws blood/life of peace/well-being offerings.

familiar.text: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the LORD, and it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.

modern.text: From the cakes he must present one portion of each offering as a contribution to the LORD. It belongs to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offering.

original.text: וְהִקְרִ֨יב מִמֶּ֤נּוּ אֶחָד֙ מִכָּל קָרְבָּ֔ן תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה לַכֹּהֵ֗ן הַזֹּרֵ֛ק אֶת דַּ֥ם הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: Flesh of sacrifice of thanksgiving peace/well-being offering shall be eaten on day of bringing-near; none of it shall be left until morning.

familiar.text: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

modern.text: The meat of the sacrifice of his peace offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the day he offers it; none of it may be left until morning.

original.text: וּבְשַׂ֗ר זֶ֚בַח תּוֹדַ֣ת שְׁלָמָ֔יו בְּי֥וֹם קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל לֹֽא יַנִּ֥יחַ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד בֹּֽקֶר

verses.restored: If sacrifice of his offering is vow or freewill offering, on day he brings near his sacrifice it shall be eaten, and on next day remainder from it may be eaten.

familiar.text: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

modern.text: If, however, the sacrifice he offers is a vow or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day he presents his sacrifice, but the remainder may be eaten on the next day.

original.text: וְאִם נֶ֣דֶר א֣וֹ נְדָבָ֗ה זֶ֚בַח קָרְבָּנ֔וֹ בְּי֛וֹם הַקְרִיב֥וֹ אֶת זִבְח֖וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל וּמִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וְהַנּוֹתָ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יֵאָכֵֽל

verses.restored: What remains from flesh of sacrifice on third day shall be burned with fire.

familiar.text: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.

modern.text: But any meat of the sacrifice remaining until the third day must be burned up.

original.text: וְהַנּוֹתָ֖ר מִבְּשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑בַח בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף

verses.restored: If any flesh of sacrifice of his peace/well-being offering is eaten on third day, it shall not be accepted; it shall not be credited to one bringing it near. It shall be offensive, and soul/life eating from it shall bear iniquity.

familiar.text: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

modern.text: If any of the meat from his peace offering is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted. It will not be credited to the one who presented it; it shall be an abomination, and the one who eats of it shall bear his iniquity.

original.text: וְאִ֣ם הֵאָכֹ֣ל יֵ֠אָכֵל מִבְּשַׂר זֶ֨בַח שְׁלָמָ֜יו בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֮ לֹ֣א יֵרָצֶה֒ הַמַּקְרִ֣יב אֹת֗וֹ לֹ֧א יֵחָשֵׁ֛ב ל֖וֹ פִּגּ֣וּל יִהְיֶ֑ה וְהַנֶּ֛פֶשׁ הָאֹכֶ֥לֶת מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עֲוֺנָ֥הּ תִּשָּֽׂא

verses.restored: Flesh touching any unclean thing shall not be eaten; with fire it shall be burned. As for flesh, everyone clean may eat flesh.

familiar.text: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.

modern.text: Meat that touches anything unclean must not be eaten; it is to be burned up. As for any other meat, anyone who is ceremonially clean may eat it.

original.text: וְהַבָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר יִגַּ֤ע בְּכָל טָמֵא֙ לֹ֣א יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵ֑ף וְהַ֨בָּשָׂ֔ר כָּל טָה֖וֹר יֹאכַ֥ל בָּשָֽׂר

verses.restored: But soul/life who eats flesh from sacrifice of peace/well-being offering that belongs to YHWH while uncleanness is upon him, that soul/life shall be cut off from its people.

familiar.text: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

modern.text: But if anyone who is unclean eats meat from the peace offering that belongs to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people.

original.text: וְהַנֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֗ר מִזֶּ֤בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהוָ֔ה וְטֻמְאָת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ

verses.restored: When a soul/life touches any unclean thing, human uncleanness, unclean beast, or any unclean detestable thing, and eats from flesh of sacrifice of peace/well-being offering that belongs to YHWH, that soul/life shall be cut off from its people.

familiar.text: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

modern.text: If one touches anything unclean, whether human uncleanness, an unclean animal, or any unclean, detestable thing, and then eats any of the meat of the peace offering that belongs to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people.” Fat and Blood Forbidden

original.text: וְנֶ֜פֶשׁ כִּֽי תִגַּ֣ע בְּכָל טָמֵ֗א בְּטֻמְאַ֤ת אָדָם֙ א֣וֹ בִּבְהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֗ה א֚וֹ בְּכָל שֶׁ֣קֶץ טָמֵ֔א וְאָכַ֛ל מִבְּשַׂר זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהוָ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel, saying: Any fat of ox, sheep, or goat you shall not eat.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘You are not to eat any of the fat of an ox, a sheep, or a goat.

original.text: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר כָּל חֵ֜לֶב שׁ֥וֹר וְכֶ֛שֶׂב וָעֵ֖ז לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ

verses.restored: Fat of carcass and fat of torn animal may be used for any work, but eating, you shall not eat it.

familiar.text: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.

modern.text: The fat of an animal found dead or mauled by wild beasts may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.

original.text: וְחֵ֤לֶב נְבֵלָה֙ וְחֵ֣לֶב טְרֵפָ֔ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לְכָל מְלָאכָ֑ה וְאָכֹ֖ל לֹ֥א תֹאכְלֻֽהוּ

verses.restored: For everyone eating fat from beast from which fire-offering is brought near to YHWH, the soul/life eating shall be cut off from its people.

familiar.text: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.

modern.text: If anyone eats the fat of an animal from which an offering made by fire may be presented to the LORD, the one who eats it must be cut off from his people.

original.text: כִּ֚י כָּל אֹכֵ֣ל חֵ֔לֶב מִן הַ֨בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֥יב מִמֶּ֛נָּה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הָאֹכֶ֖לֶת מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ

verses.restored: Any blood/life you shall not eat in any of your dwellings, from bird or beast.

familiar.text: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

modern.text: You must not eat the blood of any bird or animal in any of your dwellings.

original.text: וְכָל דָּם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכְל֔וּ בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לָע֖וֹף וְלַבְּהֵמָֽה

verses.restored: Any soul/life who eats any blood/life, that soul/life shall be cut off from its people.

familiar.text: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

modern.text: If anyone eats blood, that person must be cut off from his people.’” The Priests’ Portion

original.text: כָּל נֶ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַ֣ל כָּל דָּ֑ם וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel, saying: One bringing near sacrifice of peace/well-being offering to YHWH shall bring his offering to YHWH from sacrifice of his peace/well-being.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘Anyone who presents a peace offering to the LORD must bring it as his sacrifice to the LORD.

original.text: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הַמַּקְרִ֞יב אֶת זֶ֤בַח שְׁלָמָיו֙ לַיהוָ֔ה יָבִ֧יא אֶת קָרְבָּנ֛וֹ לַיהוָ֖ה מִזֶּ֥בַח שְׁלָמָֽיו

verses.restored: His hands shall bring fire-offerings of YHWH: fat with breast he shall bring, the breast to wave it as wave offering before YHWH.

familiar.text: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.

modern.text: With his own hands he is to bring the offerings made by fire to the LORD; he shall bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast as a wave offering before the LORD.

original.text: יָדָ֣יו תְּבִיאֶ֔ינָה אֵ֖ת אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת הַחֵ֤לֶב עַל הֶֽחָזֶה֙ יְבִיאֶ֔נּוּ אֵ֣ת הֶחָזֶ֗ה לְהָנִ֥יף אֹת֛וֹ תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: The priest shall turn fat into smoke on altar, and breast shall belong to Aaron and his sons.

familiar.text: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

modern.text: The priest is to burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.

original.text: וְהִקְטִ֧יר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת הַחֵ֖לֶב הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְהָיָה֙ הֶֽחָזֶ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָֽיו

verses.restored: Right thigh you shall give as contribution to priest from sacrifices of your peace/well-being offerings.

familiar.text: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

modern.text: And you are to give the right thigh to the priest as a contribution from your peace offering.

original.text: וְאֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַיָּמִ֔ין תִּתְּנ֥וּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵ֑ן מִזִּבְחֵ֖י שַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: The one among sons of Aaron who brings near blood/life of peace/well-being offerings and fat, right thigh shall be his as portion.

familiar.text: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.

modern.text: The son of Aaron who presents the blood and fat of the peace offering shall have the right thigh as a portion.

original.text: הַמַּקְרִ֞יב אֶת דַּ֧ם הַשְּׁלָמִ֛ים וְאֶת הַחֵ֖לֶב מִבְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן ל֧וֹ תִהְיֶ֛ה שׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִ֖ין לְמָנָֽה

verses.restored: For breast of wave offering and thigh of contribution I have taken from children of Israel, from sacrifices of their peace/well-being offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as age-long due from children of Israel.

familiar.text: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.

modern.text: I have taken from the sons of Israel the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution of their peace offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as a permanent portion from the sons of Israel.’”

original.text: כִּי֩ אֶת חֲזֵ֨ה הַתְּנוּפָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה לָקַ֨חְתִּי֙ מֵאֵ֣ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִזִּבְחֵ֖י שַׁלְמֵיהֶ֑ם וָאֶתֵּ֣ן אֹ֠תָם לְאַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֤ן וּלְבָנָיו֙ לְחָק עוֹלָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: This is anointed portion of Aaron and anointed portion of his sons from fire-offerings of YHWH, on day he brought them near to serve as priests to YHWH,

familiar.text: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest’s office;

modern.text: This is the portion of the offerings made by fire to the LORD for Aaron and his sons since the day they were presented to serve the LORD as priests.

original.text: זֹ֣את מִשְׁחַ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וּמִשְׁחַ֣ת בָּנָ֔יו מֵאִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה בְּיוֹם֙ הִקְרִ֣יב אֹתָ֔ם לְכַהֵ֖ן לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: which YHWH commanded to give them on day he anointed them from children of Israel, age-long statute throughout generations.

familiar.text: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.

modern.text: On the day they were anointed, the LORD commanded that this be given them by the sons of Israel. It is a permanent portion for the generations to come.

original.text: אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֗ם בְּיוֹם֙ מָשְׁח֣וֹ אֹתָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם

verses.restored: This is Torah/instruction for burnt offering, grain offering, sin/misalignment offering, guilt/reparation offering, filling/ordination offering, and sacrifice of peace/well-being,

familiar.text: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;

modern.text: This is the law of the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering, and the peace offering,

original.text: זֹ֣את הַתּוֹרָ֗ה לָֽעֹלָה֙ לַמִּנְחָ֔ה וְלַֽחַטָּ֖את וְלָאָשָׁ֑ם וְלַ֨מִּלּוּאִ֔ים וּלְזֶ֖בַח הַשְּׁלָמִֽים

verses.restored: which YHWH commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on day he commanded children of Israel to bring near their offerings to YHWH, in wilderness of Sinai.

familiar.text: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

modern.text: which the LORD gave Moses on Mount Sinai on the day He commanded the Israelites to present their offerings to the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai.

original.text: אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּהַ֣ר סִינָ֑י בְּי֨וֹם צַוֺּת֜וֹ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְהַקְרִ֧יב אֶת קָרְבְּנֵיהֶ֛ם לַיהוָ֖ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי

translation_notes: Peace/well-being offering includes thanksgiving, vow, and freewill contexts; timing rules preserve holy meal integrity.
Leavened bread appears with thanksgiving peace offering, proving leaven is not universally negative.
Fat/blood prohibitions remain ritual reverence for abundance/life, not body-shame.
Priestly portions are structured provision from offerings, not private profiteering.
Chapter closes as summary Torah for main offering categories.
safety_note: Do not use cut-off language for modern shaming or exclusion. Preserve ritual seriousness while reading within ancient covenant meal/holiness boundaries.
